description: This file defines the 'MinimumVersionSelector' class that implements the 'IVersionSelector' interface to select the minimum compatible version among available versions based on a compatibility check.

classes.name: MinimumVersionSelector
classes.description: A class that selects the minimum compatible version from a list of available versions.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Selects and returns the minimum version from 'availableVersions' that is compatible with the requested version as determined by the 'compatibilityDirector'.
